statement.essentials: The facial nerve leaves the skull through a small opening behind the ear, between two bony points, and passes straight into the parotid gland.
statement.anatomy: The extratemporal facial nerve exits the stylomastoid foramen, between the styloid and mastoid processes, and enters the posteromedial surface of the parotid gland.

limitations: Wording taken from narrative and reference sources; not a measurement.
